name: Synthetic Human: Latent Immune System III

system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 4

(You must have Latent Immune System II) Beginning at 18th level, you can provide antibodies to others to via blood transfusion by spending 1 hit die per creature, granting the affected creature advantage on saving throws to resist the effects of viruses and diseases for 1 hour. You also gain immunity to poison damage and effects caused by poison damage.
